summary: License seat transfer + unused-seat audit for UI/UX and Solutions teams ahead of renewals
description:
Issue summary:
Support request to centralize and transfer a block of 50 Figma seats from the Solutions org to the UI/UX org and to run an immediate unused-seat audit across three vendors (Figma, Looker, and Sentry) before the upcoming renewal window. Team requests transfers + a short report showing seats inactive >60 days so Finance can retire or reassign them prior to contract renewal to avoid overage charges.

Impact:
- Potential annual overspend if unused seats are renewed: estimated $12k-$18k if not reclaimed.
- UI/UX team cannot onboard 12 new hires starting 2026-04-01 without seat transfers; product ramp may be delayed.
- Procurement needs the audit report to finalize vendor negotiation strategy by 2026-03-22.

Background / Context:
- Solutions currently holds an organization-level Figma entitlement pool purchased in 2024; several seats were allocated to temporary contractors and an incubator project that ended in 2025.
- UI/UX has urgent hiring and cannot wait for a new purchase approval cycle.
- Contract renewals for Figma and Sentry are scheduled for 2026-04-15 and Looker for 2026-05-02.

Request / Acceptance criteria:
1) Enable immediate transfer of up to 50 Figma seats from Solutions to UI/UX by 2026-03-18 (or provide a temporary allocation until renewal).
2) Produce a vendor-agnostic unused-seat audit report covering Figma, Looker, and Sentry showing: user, last active date, license type, org allocation, and recommended action (reassign/retire).
3) Estimated cost savings and recommended negotiation levers for each vendor (e.g., committed term, seat tier reduction, contractor cleanup).
4) Hand-off artifact for Finance and Vendor Management to use in renewal discussions.

Environment:
- Internal SaaS vendors: Figma (org: solutions.redwood), Looker (BI workspace redwood-bi-prod), Sentry (org: redwood-inference).
- Region: multi-cloud corporate accounts (no customer data involved).

Steps to obtain audit (suggested):
1) Run admin reports in each vendor console for last activity date and license assignment.
2) Cross-reference with Okta SCIM sync logs for deprovisioned accounts.
3) Use provisioning logs from HRIS (BambooHR export) to correlate contractor end dates.
4) Collate into a single CSV and run a filter for last_active > 60 days and not in HRIS active list.

Attachments / Logs:
- Slack thread: #procurement (link: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/CPROC/archives/CA12345)
- Partial export attached in initial triage (see internal-tools PR for parsing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal-tools/pull/214)

Business owner / approvals:
- Business owner: Maya Thompson (Head of Design) approved seat reallocation on 2026-03-05 by email (see confluence page).
- Finance owner: Luis Chen (Billing) requested cost estimates before 2026-03-22.

Timeline / SLA:
- First response: immediate (P2 but time-sensitive because of new hires).
- Target transfer completion: 2026-03-18.
- Audit report delivery: 2026-03-17.

Acceptance criteria (how ticket will be marked resolved):
- Figma seats transferred or temporary allocation confirmed and documented.
- Audit CSV and summary recommendations uploaded to confluence and linked here.
- Finance acknowledges report and includes recommended actions in renewal meeting notes.

Investigation notes (triage so far):
- 2026-03-08: Procurement confirmed seat counts in billing portal; Solutions org has 320 total seats with 48 marked as "guest" or contractor accounts.
- 2026-03-09: Okta SCIM shows 37 deprovision events in last 180 days tied to contractor email domains.
- 2026-03-11: Initial CSV export (partial) available in internal-tools PR #214 — parsing script flagged 14 accounts with last_active > 120 days.

Next steps (owner: Ravi Patel):
- Run full admin exports for the three vendors (due 2026-03-12).
- Cross-reference with HRIS active list and Okta within 48 hours of export.
- Produce audit CSV and summary doc and post to the linked Confluence page.
- Coordinate temporary seat allocation with Solutions admin if transfer APIs are unavailable.
